_comment: English translation of BL-RMO. Key: French text as written in the code; value: English. A missing key stays in French.
(aucune station suivie : la choisir dan: (no watched station: choose it in Settings)
(« Station suivie »). Sans station suivi: ("Watched station"). No watched station, no logger. After a station change, existing recordings are kept until the end of their retention.
Afficher l'analyseur de spectre (mémoris: Show the spectrum analyser (remembered in this browser)
Alertes FM, DAB+ et chaîne des dernières: FM, DAB+ and chain alerts over the last 24 h: details in each page's Log
Aucun récepteur détecté. Vérifier les br: No receiver detected. Check the USB connections.
Aucun récepteur reconnu (TEF, dongle Si4: No receiver recognised (TEF, Si468x dongle or RTL-SDR dongle).
Aucune station DAB+ suivie, donc pas de: No watched DAB+ station, so no logger: choose the station in the {tab} tab ("Watched station").
Brancher le dongle Si468x et son antenne: Connect the Si468x dongle and its band III antenna
Brancher une clé RTL-SDR dédiée au DAB+: Connect an RTL-SDR dongle dedicated to DAB+ and its band III antenna
Ce moment n'est plus dans la pige : extr: This moment is no longer in the logger: archived clip of the alert of {t}, from 30 s before to 30 s after the restoration
Chaque nouveau RadioText reçu par le tun: Each new RadioText received by the tuner, with the time it first appeared. A text that keeps coming back (station name, slogan) is only listed again after 10 minutes.
Chaque nouveau texte DLS de la station s: Each new DLS text of the watched station, with the time it first appeared. A text that keeps coming back (station name, slogan) is only listed again after 10 minutes.
Choisir la source active (BL-RMO redémar: Choose the active source (BL-RMO restarts FM reception):
Choisir le récepteur, le canal et la sta: Choose the receiver, the channel and the watched station in the tab
Choose a date and a start time.
Cliquer sur « Détecter les récepteurs »: Click "Detect receivers": connected RTL-SDR dongle, Si468x dongle and TEF, with their port and sound card. No port is opened.
Connexion requise pour écouter le DAB+: Sign in to listen to DAB+
Décodage en carrousel : la station n'est: Carousel decoding: the station is only decoded in turn and the logger will have gaps. Choose "Watched station only" or "All services continuously" in the Settings tab.
Décodage par welle-cli : plusieurs servi: Decoding by welle-cli: several services possible.
En attente du son du tuner: Waiting for audio from the tuner
Enregistré. Le service DAB+ applique les: Saved. The DAB+ service applies the settings within a few seconds.
environ {day} par jour · pige actuelle {: about {day} per day · current logger {used} · {free} free on disk.
Environ {day} par jour à 128 kb/s · pige: About {day} per day at 128 kb/s · current logger {used} · {free} free on disk. Clips of the latest alerts are kept after they leave the logger.
Extrait archivé, de 30 s avant à 30 s ap: Archived clip, from 30 s before to 30 s after
Extrait MP3 ({p}) de 30 s avant à 30 s a: MP3 clip ({p}) from 30 s before to 30 s after
Extrait MP3 de 30 s avant à 30 s après: MP3 clip from 30 s before to 30 s after
fin de la dernière alerte le {t}: end of the last alert on {t}
Fin non enregistrée (redémarrage de la s: End not recorded (monitoring restarted during the alert)
Fin non enregistrée (surveillance DAB+ r: End not recorded (DAB+ monitoring restarted during the alert)
Gain de la clé RTL-SDR (tuner R820T/R828: RTL-SDR dongle gain (R820T/R828D tuner). welle-cli's automatic gain can delay synchronisation by several minutes; a fixed gain syncs within seconds.
Historique complet du service choisi (CS: Full history of the selected service (CSV)
Interface et mails d'alerte, pour tous l: Interface and alert mails, for all accounts. Saved as soon as you choose.
L'expéditeur, les destinataires et la co: The sender, the recipients and the global mail switch are set in
La pige DAB+ apparaît quand la réception: The DAB+ logger appears when DAB+ reception is enabled.
La pige DAB+ de ce service n'enregistre: The DAB+ logger of this service is not recording: start listening to see the spectrum
The DAB+ logger of this service stopped recording: start listening to see the spectrum
La pige enregistre la station DAB+ suivi: The logger records the watched DAB+ station, chosen in the tab
La pige enregistre seulement la station: The logger only records the watched station
La station est surveillée et enregistrée: The station is monitored and recorded by the DAB+ logger.
Le serveur a refusé la connexion (erreur: The server refused the sign-in (error {n}): reload the page.
Le service de réception DAB+ ne répond p: The DAB+ reception service does not respond
Le service {sid} n'est pas reçu pour le: Service {sid} is not received at the moment.
Le tuner TEF n'est plus détecté sur le p: The TEF tuner is no longer detected on the USB port: check its cable.
Lecture à partir de l'heure de début. In: Plays from the start time. Set an end time to download.
Les 38 canaux de 5A à 13F, environ 1 min: The 38 channels from 5A to 13F, about 1 min 30. Possible when the dongle is not doing DAB+ monitoring ("RTL-SDR dongle" receiver in the settings, or reception disabled).
Les alertes décochées restent enregistré: Unticked alerts are still recorded in the logs and on the dashboard, without a mail.
Mesurées par le tuner, comme un auditeur: Measured by the tuner, like a listener. A first mail is sent when the alert is confirmed, a second when it is restored. "Listen" opens the logger at the time of the alert, or its archived clip.
Mesurées sur le multiplex reçu. Un mail: Measured on the received multiplex. A mail is sent at the alert, a second at the restoration. "Listen" opens the Logger tab at the time of the alert, for the watched station and alerts on the whole multiplex.
Multiplex reçu par la clé RTL-SDR et wel: Multiplex received by the RTL-SDR dongle and welle-cli
Niveau reçu par le tuner, crête en dBFS: Level received by the tuner, peak in dBFS
Niveau reçu sous lequel la modulation es: Received level below which modulation is considered missing
Ouvrir la pige 30 s avant l'alerte: Open the logger 30 s before the alert
Ouvrir le flux dans un autre onglet ou u: Open the stream in another tab or an external player
Ouvrir le flux MP3 dans un autre onglet: Open the MP3 stream in another tab or an external player (one DAB+ listener at a time)
Pas de pige DAB+ pour ce service : lance: No DAB+ logger for this service: start listening to see the spectrum
Pas de réception DAB+ : choisir un récep: No DAB+ reception: choose a receiver in the {tab} tab, the logger starts with reception.
Pendant l'écoute : crête mesurée sur l'a: While listening: peak measured on the received audio; otherwise, level reported by welle-cli
Perte détectée par le tuner, sans seuil: Loss detected by the tuner, no threshold to set
Pige démarrée : l'enregistrement reprend: Logger started: recording resumes within 20 seconds.
Pilote TNT du noyau chargé : redémarrer: Kernel DVB-T driver loaded: reboot the machine (it is blacklisted by {f})
Réception DAB+ arrêtée, ainsi que sa pig: DAB+ reception stopped, and its logger too.
Rétablissement enregistré sans le début: Restoration recorded without the start of the alert (start before a restart)
Service affiché sur le tableau de bord e: Service shown on the dashboard and recorded by the DAB+ logger
Session fermée après 60 minutes d'inacti: Session closed after 60 minutes of inactivity: please sign in again.
Seule la station suivie est surveillée (: Only the watched station is monitored (silence, missing). Changing the channel or decoding restarts reception.
Silence audio de la station suivie: Audio silence on the watched station
Source {s} activée, la réception FM redé: Source {s} enabled, FM reception is restarting.
Spectre en tiers d'octave, 31 bandes · t: Third-octave spectrum, 31 bands · dark line: peak of the last 2 seconds
Station suivie absente du multiplex: Watched station missing from the multiplex
Surveillance radio FM, DAB+ et chaîne de: FM, DAB+ and broadcast chain radio monitoring
Trop de tentatives : réessayez dans une: Too many attempts: try again in a minute.
Un changement de fréquence relance la ré: Changing the frequency restarts FM reception (a few seconds of silence in listening and the logger).
Un seul service décodé : la station suiv: Only one service decoded: the watched station. The other services are still monitored (presence), without audio.
{n} multiplex trouvé sur {c} canaux, le: {n} multiplex found on {c} channels, on {d} at {h}
{n} multiplex trouvés sur {c} canaux, le: {n} multiplexes found on {c} channels, on {d} at {h}
« Station suivie seulement » : seule la: "Watched station only": only the watched station is decoded, continuously, for minimal load. The ensemble and the presence of all services are still monitored.
Écoute impossible : le service ne répond: Cannot listen: the service does not respond right now. Try again in a few seconds.
Écouter l'antenne à ce moment: Listen to the broadcast at this moment
Écouter la pige {p} au moment de l'alert: Listen to the {p} logger at the time of the alert
Écouter la pige {p} à ce moment: Listen to the {p} logger at this moment
